Game theory reveals how rational individual efforts collectively create losses, such as in rent-seeking or congestion. title: 微信语音电话惊现「零接触」漏洞：未接来电账号或已被悄然劫持
content: A high-risk WeChat vulnerability, dubbed WeWorm, allows attackers to hijack user accounts via unanswered voice calls without requiring user interaction. Exploiting this flaw, attackers can remotely compromise accounts in seconds, triggering automatic voice calls to contacts to facilitate chain propagation across Android and iOS platforms. The vulnerability enables privacy theft and fraud with minimal user awareness. WeChat patched the issue in iOS 8.0.76 and Android 8.0.77, though unupgraded devices remain vulnerable. Discovered by AI security systems, the flaw highlights platform architectural weaknesses and accelerates the need for rapid cyber-defense responses to prevent derivative fraud.
